items: With jesus2099's "mb. FUNKEY ILLUSTRATED RECORDS" active, its small cover before each release group name in a list — /tag/<name>'s "Release groups", an editor's ratings — kept its plain title ("N images found in this release"). It now shows the artwork card of that release on a hover and opens the viewer on a click, as the same icon already did in a release group's Relationships section.
